title: 玻璃回收色選與純化~Color sorting and purification of recycled glass
focus: 玻璃色系、陶瓷污染與品質收支~Glass colours, ceramic contamination and quality balances
summary: 以「玻璃色系、陶瓷污染與品質收支」為主線，依序完成十個專題單元。學徒在場景中辨識設備、列出邊界、重算明示的教學算例、比較量測與模型，最後診斷故障並交付證據。每一單元保留機制、算例、驗證與失效四種學習任務。~Follow glass colours, ceramic contamination and quality balances through ten technical units. Identify equipment in the scene, define boundaries, reproduce explicitly hypothetical examples, compare measurements with models, and diagnose faults before handing over evidence. Each unit contains mechanism, calculation, verification and failure tasks.

units.title: 玻璃來源與規格~Glass sources and specifications
units.mechanism: 容器玻璃、耐熱玻璃與陶瓷成分不同；先分用途與材料來源才能設定產品品質。~Container glass, heat-resistant glass and ceramics differ in composition; define source and use before product quality.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：target cullet=feed*fraction;1000*0.85；計算 1000*0.85 = 850 kg/h。適用限制：假想容器玻璃比例。~Original hypothetical teaching example: target cullet=feed*fraction;1000*0.85; calculation 1000*0.85 = 850 kg/h. Applicability: Hypothetical container-glass fraction.
units.verify: 將耐熱玻璃與陶瓷獨立標籤。~Label heat-resistant glass and ceramics separately.
units.failure: 把透明物都當同類玻璃會引入不相容材料。~Treating every transparent item as the same glass admits incompatible material.
units.misconception: 所有透明碎片都可視為同一種容器玻璃。~All transparent fragments are the same container glass.
units.practice: 在「玻璃來源與規格」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 850 kg/h，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「把透明物都當同類玻璃會引入不相容材料。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for glass sources and specifications, first reproduce 850 kg/h, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Treating every transparent item as the same glass admits incompatible material." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 顏色照明與白平衡~Colour illumination and white balance
units.mechanism: 顏色判斷依光源光譜、曝光和背景，需用標準色樣維持一致。~Colour classification depends on illumination spectrum, exposure and background; use reference samples for consistency.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：normalized channel=G/(R+G+B);R=20,G=60,B=20；計算 60/(20+60+20) = 0.6 fraction。適用限制：簡化色特徵，不是完整分類器。~Original hypothetical teaching example: normalized channel=G/(R+G+B);R=20,G=60,B=20; calculation 60/(20+60+20) = 0.6 fraction. Applicability: Simplified colour feature, not a complete classifier.
units.verify: 降低光源強度並檢查歸一化及噪音。~Reduce illumination and check normalization and noise.
units.failure: 光源老化可能讓相同玻璃跨越色類閾值。~Lamp aging can move the same glass across colour thresholds.
units.misconception: 相機RGB值與照明條件完全無關。~Camera RGB values are independent of lighting.
units.practice: 在「顏色照明與白平衡」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.6 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「光源老化可能讓相同玻璃跨越色類閾值。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for colour illumination and white balance, first reproduce 0.6 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Lamp aging can move the same glass across colour thresholds." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 透射與不透明異物~Transmission and opaque contaminants
units.mechanism: 透射與反射資訊互補；單靠顏色可能把同色陶瓷誤認成玻璃。~Transmission and reflection complement each other; colour alone can confuse same-colour ceramics with glass.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：transmission=I/I0;30/100；計算 30/100 = 0.3 fraction。適用限制：固定厚度與波段。~Original hypothetical teaching example: transmission=I/I0;30/100; calculation 30/100 = 0.3 fraction. Applicability: Fixed thickness and wavelength band.
units.verify: 比較同色玻璃與陶瓷的透射訊號。~Compare transmission of same-colour glass and ceramics.
units.failure: 碎片厚度差異也會影響透射，不能全解讀成材質差。~Thickness also affects transmission and is not purely a material signal.
units.misconception: 同顏色就必定是同種材質。~Equal colour guarantees equal material.
units.practice: 在「透射與不透明異物」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.3 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「碎片厚度差異也會影響透射，不能全解讀成材質差。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for transmission and opaque contaminants, first reproduce 0.3 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Thickness also affects transmission and is not purely a material signal." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 粒徑與細粉~Size and fines
units.mechanism: 細粉使影像辨識和氣動分選更困難，篩分可建立適當處理路徑。~Fines challenge imaging and pneumatic sorting; screening assigns suitable processing paths.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：fines fraction=mass fines/feed;80/1000；計算 80/1000 = 0.08 fraction。適用限制：質量基準。~Original hypothetical teaching example: fines fraction=mass fines/feed;80/1000; calculation 80/1000 = 0.08 fraction. Applicability: Mass basis.
units.verify: 比較篩分前後相機可辨識物件比例。~Compare recognizable objects before and after screening.
units.failure: 細粉堆積在鏡頭或燈具會增加誤判。~Fines on optics increase classification errors.
units.misconception: 碎得越細就一定越容易做顏色辨識。~Finer crushing always makes colour recognition easier.
units.practice: 在「粒徑與細粉」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.08 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「細粉堆積在鏡頭或燈具會增加誤判。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for size and fines, first reproduce 0.08 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Fines on optics increase classification errors." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 鐵與非鐵前段移除~Upstream ferrous and non-ferrous removal
units.mechanism: 磁選和渦電流針對不同金屬，應在玻璃色選前減少混入與設備磨耗。~Magnets and eddy-current systems address different metals and reduce contamination and wear before colour sorting.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：metal residual=Min(1-eta);10*(1-0.95)；計算 10*(1-0.95) = 0.5 kg/h。適用限制：單一假想金屬去除步驟。~Original hypothetical teaching example: metal residual=Min(1-eta);10*(1-0.95); calculation 10*(1-0.95) = 0.5 kg/h. Applicability: One hypothetical metal-removal stage.
units.verify: 分別秤重鐵與非鐵產品，核對殘餘。~Weigh ferrous and non-ferrous products separately.
units.failure: 只設磁選會留下非鐵金屬。~Magnetic sorting alone leaves non-ferrous metals.
units.misconception: 磁鐵可以同樣吸走鐵、鋁與銅。~A magnet removes iron, aluminium and copper equally.
units.practice: 在「鐵與非鐵前段移除」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.5 kg/h，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「只設磁選會留下非鐵金屬。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for upstream ferrous and non-ferrous removal, first reproduce 0.5 kg/h, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Magnetic sorting alone leaves non-ferrous metals." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 噴選時序~Ejection timing
units.mechanism: 碎玻璃在皮帶上可能滑動或旋轉，速度追蹤要和噴嘴觸發聯繫。~Cullet can slip or rotate; link velocity tracking to ejector triggers.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：delay=L/v;0.8/2；計算 0.8/2 = 0.4 s。適用限制：無滑動基準。~Original hypothetical teaching example: delay=L/v;0.8/2; calculation 0.8/2 = 0.4 s. Applicability: No-slip baseline.
units.verify: 在模型加入速度偏差，量出噴選落點誤差。~Add speed error in the model and measure ejection-position error.
units.failure: 只依皮帶速度而忽略碎片滑動會偏移觸發。~Belt speed alone misses fragment slip.
units.misconception: 所有碎片速度都永遠等於皮帶速度。~Every fragment always moves at belt speed.
units.practice: 在「噴選時序」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.4 s，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「只依皮帶速度而忽略碎片滑動會偏移觸發。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for ejection timing, first reproduce 0.4 s, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Belt speed alone misses fragment slip." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 微量陶瓷污染~Trace ceramic contamination
units.mechanism: 少量不熔雜質可能影響下游熔製品質，需用足夠代表性的樣本估微量比例。~Small refractory contaminants can affect downstream melting; estimate trace fractions with representative samples.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：contamination ppm=mass impurity/mass product*1e6;0.02/1000*1e6；計算 0.02/1000*1e6 = 20 ppm by mass。適用限制：僅示例濃度，非任何玻璃廠允收值。~Original hypothetical teaching example: contamination ppm=mass impurity/mass product*1e6;0.02/1000*1e6; calculation 0.02/1000*1e6 = 20 ppm by mass. Applicability: Example concentration, not a plant acceptance limit.
units.verify: 增加樣本量並記錄稀有陶瓷片的檢出。~Increase sample mass and record rare ceramic detections.
units.failure: 小樣本未見異物不能證明全批零污染。~No contaminant in a small sample does not prove a clean batch.
units.misconception: 抽一小杯未見陶瓷即可證明整批零陶瓷。~A clean small cup proves zero ceramics in the whole batch.
units.practice: 在「微量陶瓷污染」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 20 ppm by mass，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「小樣本未見異物不能證明全批零污染。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for trace ceramic contamination, first reproduce 20 ppm by mass, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "No contaminant in a small sample does not prove a clean batch." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 顏色純度與收率~Colour purity and yield
units.mechanism: 色別產品應同時報純度與質量收率，過嚴剔除可能浪費合格玻璃。~Report colour purity and mass yield together; overly strict rejection can waste suitable glass.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：purity=correct-colour mass/product mass;570/600；計算 570/600 = 0.95 fraction。適用限制：單一色系產品。~Original hypothetical teaching example: purity=correct-colour mass/product mass;570/600; calculation 570/600 = 0.95 fraction. Applicability: Single-colour product.
units.verify: 比較兩個顏色閾值下的純度—收率曲線。~Compare purity-yield curves for two colour thresholds.
units.failure: 只追求純度會讓大量同色玻璃進殘渣。~Purity-only optimization can lose much suitable glass.
units.misconception: 剔除越多就一定是較好的回收策略。~Rejecting more material always improves recycling.
units.practice: 在「顏色純度與收率」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.95 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「只追求純度會讓大量同色玻璃進殘渣。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for colour purity and yield, first reproduce 0.95 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Purity-only optimization can lose much suitable glass." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 清洗水與標籤~Wash water and labels
units.mechanism: 附著有機物和標籤會遮蔽光學訊號；清洗改善辨識但產生污水與能耗。~Labels and organics obscure optical signals; washing helps recognition but uses water and energy and creates wastewater.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：freshwater=circulation*(1-recycle fraction);5*(1-0.8)；計算 5*(1-0.8) = 1 m3/h。適用限制：未含蒸發和帶出補水。~Original hypothetical teaching example: freshwater=circulation*(1-recycle fraction);5*(1-0.8); calculation 5*(1-0.8) = 1 m3/h. Applicability: Excludes evaporation and carryout makeup.
units.verify: 把循環水濁度升高，觀察清洗與成像品質。~Increase recycle-water turbidity and inspect cleaning and imaging.
units.failure: 循環率高但污物累積會讓產品再污染。~High recycle with contaminant buildup can re-soil product.
units.misconception: 清洗水循環率越高永遠越乾淨。~Higher wash-water recycling always produces cleaner water.
units.practice: 在「清洗水與標籤」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 1 m3/h，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「循環率高但污物累積會讓產品再污染。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for wash water and labels, first reproduce 1 m3/h, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "High recycle with contaminant buildup can re-soil product." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 批次追溯與熔製回饋~Batch traceability and melting feedback
units.mechanism: 產品批次需連結來源、色選參數、抽樣與下游回饋，才能定位異物來源。~Link batches to sources, sorting settings, samples and downstream feedback to locate contamination.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：traceable fraction=identified batches/total;47/50；計算 47/50 = 0.94 fraction。適用限制：追溯完整度，非產品品質率。~Original hypothetical teaching example: traceable fraction=identified batches/total;47/50; calculation 47/50 = 0.94 fraction. Applicability: Traceability completeness, not product quality.
units.verify: 模擬一個異常批次反查送料與分類版本。~Trace one abnormal batch back to feed and classifier version.
units.failure: 把多來源任意混料會使原因難以回溯。~Unrecorded source mixing obscures root causes.
units.misconception: 產品外觀相同就不需保留來源批次。~Identical appearance removes the need for source batches.
units.practice: 在「批次追溯與熔製回饋」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.94 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「把多來源任意混料會使原因難以回溯。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for batch traceability and melting feedback, first reproduce 0.94 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Unrecorded source mixing obscures root causes." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

history: 本課以來源所列的技術指引與研究為閱讀脈絡，並非重建某一設施的工程沿革；算例、數據與場景參數皆為原創教學假設。比較舊方法與感測、控制、資源回收整合的方法時，先固定處理功能及系統邊界，再評估效率與可靠度。~The cited technical guidance and research provide a reading pathway, not the engineering history of a particular facility. Examples, data and scene parameters are original teaching assumptions. When comparing conventional methods with integrated sensing, control and resource recovery, hold the treatment function and system boundary fixed before assessing efficiency and reliability.
